pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit irregular, jagged geometries with sharp-edged protrusions and serrated boundaries. Spatial area is variable, with larger sub-polygonal regions on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The interstitial light pelage forms a continuous network of wide, cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Continuity is maintained across the visible torso, with pixel thickness narrowing at junction vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a consistent, low-amplitude bristly texture. The 1D silhouette against the background consists of high-frequency micro-projections with uniform vertical alignment.
